paragraphs: AirPods are one of my favorite Apple products, so much so that I often wear them even when I’m not listening to anything. And soon with iOS 27, Apple will launch new AirPods upgrades that should make that a more common experience.
AirPods already offer plenty of reasons to wear them throughout the day.

Besides the obvious benefits of listening to music, a podcast, or audiobook, you might want to wear AirPods all day for their Active Noise Cancellation, Hearing Protection, or Hearing Aid features. Live Translation is another great reason to keep AirPods in.
But next month, it sounds like Apple could launch the best reason yet to wear AirPods more often.
With iOS 27 and the just-leaked AirPods with cameras, AirPods users will gain Siri AI with real-world intelligence.
Here is your first look at AirPods with Cameras in action using Visual Intelligence. This video file came from macOS 26.7 RC pic.twitter.com/yo7RI4MCeu

iOS 27’s Siri alone is a major upgrade. It can do so much more than the old Siri, delivering the AI overhaul we’ve been waiting for. And with AirPods, you can just talk to Siri wherever, whenever, without needing to pull out your iPhone or another device.
But the addition of IR cameras for visual intelligence means you’ll also be able to talk to Siri about anything you’re looking at.
